question: The NKT lymphocytes:

options.opb: They recognize lipids bound to CD1 molecules.
options.opd: They produce IL-17 in an outstanding way.

analysis: NKT lymphocytes are a unique subset of T cells that recognize lipid antigens presented by CD1 molecules. They express a semi-invariant T cell receptor (TCR) that is different from the classical TCR found on conventional T cells.
